research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: ForeScout Technologies is researching and developing systems for agentless device visibility and control, focusing on device classification, network traffic analysis, and risk assessment. Titles such as Device visibility and scanning including network segments and Agentless network traffic mapping describe methods for scanning and mapping devices without agents. Abstracts detail classification using machine learning, adaptive scanning, compliance monitoring, and segmentation management, highlighting efforts in network security, device profiling, and automated threat detection.

about_short_description.short_description: ForeScout Technologies provides enterprises and government agencies with agentless visibility and control of devices.

product.name: Forescout Vistaro™ Platform
product.description: An agentless cybersecurity platform for discovering, assessing, controlling, and governing managed and unmanaged assets across IT, OT, IoT, and IoMT environments.

product.name: Forescout VistaroAI™
product.description: An AI suite that analyzes asset intelligence, exposure changes, threat context, and policy posture to support cybersecurity investigation, prioritization, and response.

product.name: Universal Zero Trust Network Access (UZTNA)
product.description: A zero-trust access control offering that continuously evaluates and controls users, devices, and connections across IT, OT, IoT, and IoMT networks.

product.name: Continuous Threat Exposure Management
product.description: A service and platform capability for continuously discovering assets, assessing exposure, prioritizing cybersecurity risk, and monitoring compliance.

product.name: OT & Cyber-Physical Systems Security
product.description: Agentless security for operational technology and cyber-physical systems, including asset discovery, anomaly monitoring, and threat detection.

product.name: IoT and Medical Device Security
product.description: Security capabilities for discovering, classifying, monitoring, and controlling IoT, edge, and connected medical devices.
